newsitem.title: UK: Transco sells Fri flex gas at 11.91 pence a therm.
newsitem.headline: Transco sells Fri flex gas at 11.91 pence a therm.

text.p: British Gas plc's pipeline division Transco sold gas at 11.91 pence per therm on the flexibility mechanism on Friday.

A spokeswoman for Transco, which operates Britain's trunk gas pipeline network, the National Transmission System (NTS), said that Transco received 19 system sell bids from shippers on Friday and sold 87,752,864 kilowatt hours (2.99 million therms) of gas.
The shippers paid an System Average Price (SAP) of 0.4065 pence per kilowatt hour (11.91 pence per therm) for the gas.
Nothing was traded on the flexibility mechanism over the weekend, the spokeswoman said.
The flexibility mechanism was introduced to facilitate daily system balancing, now mandatory under the Network Code.
